models_evaluated: AI-ECG structural heart disease probability tool

links.outcome: AI-ECG HCM probability scores in confirmed HCM patients, a population differing from general-population development
links.effect: Median HCM probability 38.8% (IQR 12.8-63.4%); only 41.2% scored >50% and 12.5% >75% despite all patients having confirmed HCM.
links.quote: Despite all patients having confirmed HCM, the AI-calculated HCM probabilities showed a relatively uniform distribution [median 38.8% (IQR: 12.8-63.4%)], with only 41.2% and 12.5% of patients receiving a probability score >50% and >75%.

links.outcome: AI-ECG tool performance on a specific disease cohort versus confirmed diagnosis
links.effect: Modest performance in the HCM cohort; only 41.2% of confirmed HCM patients scored >50% HCM probability; SHD probabilities >50% in 51.2%.
links.quote: AI-based ECG analysis tools demonstrated modest performance in our HCM cohort.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic performance and calibration/generalizability of existing AI-ECG tools in a specific disease cohort (hypertrophic cardiomyopathy) using retrospective ECGs, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
